Split heats in young bitches—period of proestrus (may be prolonged to 6 weeks or more), followed by cessation of signs, and subsequent resumption of estrus cycle (1–3 weeks later); no initial rise in progesterone or LH concentration occurs with first proestrus/estrus; subsequent estrus usually normal.

Ultrasound—conceptuses can first be detected 18–20 days after LH peak (requires high-resolution, high-frequency probe, easier in toy breeds) or 2–3 days earlier in cats; commonly done 4 weeks post breeding; recommend earlier exam in bitches with history of pregnancy loss or infertility.
